segments.line: The fuel light comes on
Ten kilometers left Five
Then the engine coughs and dies right at the foot of the hill where you arrived
You turn the key again Nothing Not even a click
The tunnel is gone It's just a hillside Grass and rocks
Behind you far away a line of torches is coming down the road You can already hear the horses
Mo gets out first Then he freezes He points at the ground
Tire tracks In the dust Fresh ones And they're not yours
The pattern is different
Then from somewhere over the hill you hear it
Faint but impossible to miss An engine
You were never the only one
So what would you do Give the car to the emperor or run for the tunnel
Tell me in the comments
And is any of this real The history is
Caesar really banned carts by day
The Circus Maximus really held a hundred and fifty thousand people
And nobody in Europe could distill alcohol for another thousand years
And whoever made those tracks
You'll find out in part two
